summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/false; no dracut rebuild needed since usb-storage is not present in the initramfs). Verified the module cannot load immediately, restarted node1 with shutdown -r now, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified post-reboot that the config persisted and the module remains blocked.
actions_performed: Checked node1 OS (RHEL 9.8) and confirmed usb-storage was not loaded at baseline
Confirmed usb-storage is not built into the current initramfs, so no dracut rebuild required
Verified explicit modprobe usb-storage fails and module stays unloaded (immediate effect)
Captured baseline boot_id and uptime before restart
Issued shutdown -r now as a backgrounded nohup so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming boot_id changed (55595e92... -> d97265e9...) and uptime -s advanced
Post-restart, verified blacklist config file persisted, module absent from lsmod, and modprobe still blocked by the install directive

evidence.requirement: Baseline: usb-storage not loaded before change
evidence.summary: lsmod showed no usb_storage entry prior to blacklisting

evidence.requirement: Blacklist config created to stop module loading now and after reboot
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf containing blacklist and install /bin/false directives; confirmed file contents

evidence.requirement: Initramfs does not embed usb-storage (no rebuild needed for early-boot blocking)
evidence.summary: lsinitrd search for usb_storage in the current initramfs returned no match
modprobe usb-storage failed via the install /bin/false directive and lsmod confirmed the module was not inserted

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 and uptime -s 2026-09-04 23:39:57 prior to reboot
shutdown -r now issued via backgrounded nohup; exec returned reboot_issued before the node dropped

evidence.requirement: Node restart in progress / unreachable window
evidence.summary: Subsequent polling calls timed out, confirming the node was down during the restart

evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: New boot_id d97265e9-a954-4f2a-8958-5ad37f2423cb and new uptime -s 2026-09-04 23:41:13, differing from baseline, confirming an actual reboot occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery: blacklist persisted and module still blocked (task outcome durable across reboot)
evidence.summary: After reboot, blacklist config file still present with original content, lsmod shows no usb_storage, and modprobe usb-storage still fails via install /bin/false
